name: Austin Youth Council
org: City of Austin Economic Development (Youth Initiatives)
what_you_do: Meet monthly, hear from City staff, plan actions on community issues and talk with City Council members. Members learn Robert's Rules of Order. They also go to monthly service events.
who_can_apply: High school students who live in the City of Austin or its Extraterritorial Jurisdiction (ETJ). Students who only attend school in Austin are not eligible. No citizenship rule. A 2.5 GPA or higher is preferred, but applicants are read as a whole.
pay_detail: Pay is not mentioned on the page.
duration: Monthly meetings and service events. Term length is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says 2027 to 2028 applications are expected to open in Spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Watch the program page for the application in Spring 2027. Send questions to the program coordinator. Her email is abrianna.citta01@austintexas.gov.
notes: Members may attend national conferences each year, including one in Washington, D.C. The page does not say who pays for travel.
